title: SparKV: Overhead-Aware KV Cache Loading for Efficient On-Device LLM Inference
abstract: arXiv:2604.21231v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Efficient inference for on-device Large Language Models (LLMs) remains challenging due to limited hardware resources and the high cost of the prefill stage, which processes the full input context to construct Key-Value (KV) caches. We present SparKV, an adaptive KV loading framework that combines cloud-based KV streaming with on-device computation. SparKV models the cost of individual KV chunks and decides whether each chunk should be streamed or computed locally, while overlapping the two execution paths to reduce latency. To handle fluctuations in wireless connectivity and edge resource availability, SparKV further refines offline-generated schedules at runtime to rebalance communication and computation costs. translated_title: SparKV：面向高效端侧大语言模型推理的开销感知KV缓存加载
translated_abstract: 由于硬件资源有限以及预填充阶段的高昂开销——该阶段需要处理完整输入上下文以构建键值（KV）缓存——在设备端实现大语言模型的高效推理仍然充满挑战。我们提出了SparKV，这是一种将云端KV流式传输与端侧计算相结合的自适应KV加载框架。SparKV对单个KV分块的开销进行建模，决定每个分块应采用流式传输还是本地计算，并通过重叠两条执行路径来降低延迟。为应对无线连接和边缘资源可用性的波动，SparKV还会在运行时对离线生成的调度方案进行细化，以重新平衡通信与计算开销。在多种数据集、大语言模型和边缘设备上的实验表明，SparKV将首Token生成时间（Time-to-First-Token）降低了1.3倍至5.1倍，而对响应质量的影响可以忽略不计，同时将每个请求的能耗降低至原来的1/1.5以下……
tldr: SparKV提出了一种开销感知的自适应KV缓存加载框架，通过在云端流式传输与端侧本地计算之间逐分块动态决策并重叠两条执行路径，将端侧LLM推理的首Token生成时间降低1.3-5.1倍，同时显著降低能耗。
en_tdlr: SparKV is an overhead-aware adaptive KV cache loading framework that dynamically decides whether each KV chunk should be streamed from the cloud or computed on-device while overlapping the two execution paths, reducing Time-to-First-Token by 1.3x–5.1x with lower energy consumption for on-device LLM inference.
